QuestInfo.name: Trickery at Play
QuestInfo.1: Someone who looks like you was spotted in #b#m200000000##k. Could it be the robed people from before? Find #b#p2012012##k in #b#m200000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: How can there be somoene else in Maple World who looks just like you? Can this be mere coincidence?

0.0: What are you scheming, commander?\r\n#L0##bI beg your pardon?#l\n#k
0.1: Don't feign ignorance. You were sighted fraternizing with a group of suspicious men in #m200000000#. That WAS you, wasn't it?\r\n#L0# #b(Did those Watchmen tell?!) I have nothing whatsoever to do with those suspicious men, but I shall look into it. I have an idea.#l\n#k
0.2: Then I'll give you the benefit of the doubt... for now.

yes.0: Go to #b#p2012012##k in #b#m200000000##k. She's the one who sighted you. If you're doing something behind my back, I swear I'll make you pay for it.

no.0: You said you had nothing to do with them. Were you lying to me?!

1.0: You mean the men in robes? I didn't actually, like, see them, I just heard about them.
